project: Before the Rain / 雨来之前
direction: Restrained cut-paper botanical silhouettes and limited screenprint palettes; all runtime graphics are drawn in code.

code_native_art.source: Original project procedural drawing, revised by Codex; no external reference images or artist imitation.
code_native_art.collision_contract: Game model remains authoritative. Visual cues derive from the same flower direction, charge threshold, stamina eligibility and shelter location. Stem tips taper inside original rectangular bounds; thin decorative plant stems do not add collision.

ui.source: Project Godot drawing and controls in main.gd; operating-system Chinese font fallback
ui.stamina: Five 20-point segments, numeric current stamina, pending burst cost highlight and delayed loss trail
ui.clock: Elapsed journey time in acts 1-2; 55-second exposed-time budget in act 3, paused under shelter

rejected_pass.status: Removed from source/runtime/export following user feedback SF-R02: AI feeling too strong.
rejected_pass.retention: Original unchanged images, full image-generation prompts/provenance, native captures and interim app retained only in local outputs/swarm-flight/2026-10-20-finished-chapter/rejected-painted-pass; not required at runtime.

validation.engine: Godot 4.6.2 stable, OpenGL Compatibility on Apple M1 Pro
validation.result: Developer inspected actual native-rendered states for coherent visual language, readable silhouettes, direction/state cues and menu layout. Final revision awaits whole-chapter player review; no commercial-art acceptance claimed.
